payload.title: Edge stack owned by the CMS backend
payload.description: papyrus-edge-anth-us (and the other sites' papyrus-edge-* stacks) were hand-run CloudFormation at cutover. The site template already supports distribution create/accept (distribution: { create, aliases, acm } or edgeDistributionArn). Bring each site's edge under its CMS backend so one app owns everything, without downtime or a domain re-association (Amplify domain throttle, see the papyrus-production notes). Change sets need Ryan's approval.
